en: A ramp reduces the force needed to lift a heavy box by increasing the distance over which the force is applied.
Rubber tires grip a wet road better than smooth plastic wheels because rubber creates more friction against the surface.
The Moon orbits Earth because Earth's gravitational pull constantly pulls the Moon inward, preventing it from flying off into space.
An electromagnet loses its magnetic field immediately when the electric current flowing through its coiled copper wire is turned off.
A closed circuit allows electrons to flow continuously from the battery's negative terminal, through the wire, to the positive terminal.
A prism separates white light into a rainbow of colors because different colors of light bend at different angles passing through glass.
Striking a drum causes its tight skin to vibrate, pushing nearby air molecules to transmit sound waves to your ear.
Heat travels from hot soup to a cold metal spoon as fast-moving soup molecules collide with slower spoon molecules.
A stretched rubber band stores potential energy, which instantly transforms into kinetic energy when released to fly across the room.
A seesaw lifts a heavy child with less effort when the lighter child sits further from the central pivot point.
Two magnets push each other apart when their identical north poles face each other because like magnetic poles always repel.
The Sun warms your skin through radiation by sending invisible infrared waves through the empty vacuum of space.
